findings.issue: Same-day weather (temp, hum, windspeed, weather_severity) is treated as available at prediction time; this assumes the forecaster knows the day's weather, not just the day's date.
findings.why_it_matters: Not target leakage (check_identity is clean and it is disclosed in the code comment), but the valid/test R^2 numbers are conditional on this input-availability assumption; a pure day-ahead forecast without same-day weather would score lower.

findings.issue: Uncommitted experiment code (target-transform variants) sits in the working tree on top of the committed pipeline; it is correctly kept out of fit_and_score and metrics.json, but the audited working tree differs from the last commit.
findings.why_it_matters: Minor provenance nit, not a methodology error: the experiment writes nothing (verified), yet committing it would make the committed repo match the audited one exactly.
